package observer_test

import (
 "context"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "runtime"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/google/uuid"
 "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/baselineobservation"
 platformhttpserver "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/httpserver"
 "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/root"
 "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/edges"
 sessions "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/factory_sessions"
)

type profileManifest struct {
 SchemaVersion int `json:"schemaVersion"`
 Identity struct {
  SourceCommit,SourceStatus,ToolCommit,ToolStatus string
  ArtifactPath,ArtifactSHA256,PreparationManifestPath,PreparationManifestSHA256 string
  OverlayPath,OverlaySHA256,GoVersion,BuildCommand,Mode string
  BackingFiles []struct{Path,SHA256 string}
 }
 ChildPaths map[string]string
 MethodSHA256 string
}
type sampleProfile struct {
 Mode string
 Cycles []profileCycle
 CapacityWitnesses []profileCapacityWitness
 Manifest profileManifest
 ManifestPath,ManifestSHA256 string
 Attempts []profileAttempt
 Final []profileCheckpoint
 Errors,CleanupErrors []string
 LastBarrier string
 CaptureNs int64
 SnapshotCount,Callbacks int
 Started string
}

// Full profiling is deliberately unavailable until the same artifact also
// implements the composed public Models capacity witness.
func TestLifecycleProfile(t *testing.T) {
 if testing.Short(){t.Skip("dedicated lifecycle profile; no construction under -short")}
 t.Fatal("full profile unsupported: composed public Models capacity remains required; use TestLifecycleProfileSamplesCapability or the incomplete replacement diagnostic")
}
func TestLifecycleProfileCapability(t *testing.T) {
 if testing.Short(){t.Skip("dedicated composed capability")}
 r:=newSampleProfile("capability")
 defer r.emit(t)
 r.load(t)
 baselineobservation.Close();defer baselineobservation.Close()
 artifact:=smokeArtifact(t)
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(t.Context(),2*time.Minute);defer cancel()
 r.session(t,ctx,artifact)
 r.Errors=append(r.Errors,"composed Models capacity unsupported: replacement diagnostic retained; story 003 must supply a real public acquisition witness")
 t.Error(r.Errors[len(r.Errors)-1])
}

func newSampleProfile(mode string)*sampleProfile {
 return &sampleProfile{Mode:mode,Cycles:[]profileCycle{},CapacityWitnesses:[]profileCapacityWitness{},ManifestPath:os.Getenv("OBSERVER_PROFILE_MANIFEST"),Attempts:[]profileAttempt{},Final:[]profileCheckpoint{},Errors:[]string{},CleanupErrors:[]string{},LastBarrier:"manifest identity",Started:time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)}
}

// This dedicated tool is sequential because it observes all process owners.
func TestLifecycleProfileSamplesCapability(t *testing.T) {
 if testing.Short(){t.Skip("dedicated sample capability")}
 r:=newSampleProfile("samples_capability")
 defer r.emit(t)
 r.load(t)
 baselineobservation.Close()
 defer baselineobservation.Close()
 artifact:=smokeArtifact(t)
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(t.Context(),2*time.Minute);defer cancel()
 if !r.attempt(t,"inert",func(t *testing.T,a *profileAttempt){
  r.LastBarrier="inert BuildProcess/Close"
  cleanup,stop:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer stop()
  started:=time.Now()
  process,err:=root.BuildProcess(ctx,edges.Edges{})
  if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  err=process.Close(cleanup)
  duration:=time.Since(started).Nanoseconds();a.Duration=&duration
  if err!=nil{r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Fatal(err)}
  a.Barriers=append(a.Barriers,profileBarrier{Name:"BuildProcess and Process.Close returned",Joined:true})
  a.Checkpoints=append(a.Checkpoints,r.capture(t,artifact,"SAMPLE_CLOSED",nil,nil))
 }){return}
 r.session(t,ctx,artifact)
}

func (r *sampleProfile) load(t *testing.T) {
 if !filepath.IsAbs(r.ManifestPath){t.Fatal("absolute OBSERVER_PROFILE_MANIFEST required")}
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(r.ManifestPath);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 sum:=sha256.Sum256(data);r.ManifestSHA256=hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
 if err=json.Unmarshal(data,&r.Manifest);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 m:=r.Manifest;id:=m.Identity
 if m.SchemaVersion!=1 || id.SourceStatus!="" || id.ToolStatus!="" || len(id.SourceCommit)!=40 || len(id.ToolCommit)!=40 || len(m.MethodSHA256)!=64 {t.Fatal("unqualified profile identity")}
 if id.Mode=="pin" && id.SourceCommit!="95e213cfb35b50236fd7a34ad66c797d2ee7b5b6"{t.Fatal("wrong original source pin")}
 if id.Mode!="pin" && id.Mode!="candidate"{t.Fatal("unknown preparation mode")}
 for _,item:=range []struct{Path,Hash string}{{id.ArtifactPath,id.ArtifactSHA256},{id.PreparationManifestPath,id.PreparationManifestSHA256},{id.OverlayPath,id.OverlaySHA256}} {
  if err:=checkProfileHash(item.Path,item.Hash);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 }
 if len(id.BackingFiles)==0{t.Fatal("missing overlay backing identity")}
 for _,backing:=range id.BackingFiles{if err:=checkProfileHash(backing.Path,backing.SHA256);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}}
 for _,key:=range []string{"HOME","USERPROFILE","HOMEDRIVE","HOMEPATH","APPDATA","LOCALAPPDATA","XDG_CONFIG_HOME","XDG_CACHE_HOME","GOCACHE","GOPATH","GOMODCACHE","GOTMPDIR","TEMP","TMP"} {
  value:=m.ChildPaths[key];if value==""{t.Fatalf("missing owned environment: %s",key)}
  if key!="HOMEDRIVE" && key!="HOMEPATH" {
   relative,err:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Dir(r.ManifestPath),value)
   if err!=nil || !filepath.IsAbs(value) || relative==".." || len(relative)>3 && relative[:3]==".."+string(os.PathSeparator){t.Fatalf("environment path outside handoff: %s",key)}
  }
  t.Setenv(key,value)
 }
 t.Setenv("OBSERVER_MANIFEST",id.PreparationManifestPath)
 t.Setenv("OBSERVER_ARTIFACT_SHA256",id.ArtifactSHA256)
}
func checkProfileHash(path,expected string) error {
 if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || len(expected)!=64{return fmt.Errorf("missing absolute hashed identity: %s",path)}
 data,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{return err}
 sum:=sha256.Sum256(data)
 if hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])!=expected{return fmt.Errorf("profile identity mismatch: %s",path)}
 return nil
}

func (r *sampleProfile) attempt(t *testing.T,kind string,run func(*testing.T,*profileAttempt)) bool {
 a:=profileAttempt{ID:uuid.NewString(),Kind:kind,Ordinal:1,Generations:[]string{},Noise:[]string{"shared host diagnostic; no measurement verdict"},Errors:[]string{},Barriers:[]profileBarrier{},Checkpoints:[]profileCheckpoint{}}
 passed:=t.Run(kind,func(t *testing.T){
  defer func(){if t.Failed(){a.Errors=append(a.Errors,"attempt failed at "+r.LastBarrier+"; see raw test output")}}()
  run(t,&a)
 })
 r.LastBarrier=kind+" attempt returned"
 a.Valid=passed && len(a.Errors)==0
 if err:=validateProfileAttempt(a);err!=nil {a.Valid=false;a.Errors=append(a.Errors,err.Error());t.Error(err)}
 r.Attempts=append(r.Attempts,a)
 return a.Valid
}

func (r *sampleProfile) session(t *testing.T,ctx context.Context,artifact artifactIdentity) {
 folder:=smokeFactory(t);home:=r.Manifest.ChildPaths["HOME"]
 ready:=make(chan struct{})
 effects:=edges.Edges{
  FactorySessionIDGenerator:uuid.NewString,BrowserOpener:func(context.Context,string)error{return nil},ProviderCommandRunner:smokeCommandRunner{},
  APIServerStarter:func(ctx context.Context,req platformhttpserver.StartRequest)error{
   server:=httptest.NewServer(req.Handler)
   if req.OnBound!=nil{req.OnBound(platformhttpserver.Binding{Port:req.Port})};close(ready)
   <-ctx.Done();server.CloseClientConnections();server.Close();return nil
  },
 }
 var modelGate *profileModelGate
 if r.Mode=="model_diagnostic" || r.Mode=="model_fault_diagnostic" || r.Mode=="model_cancel_diagnostic" {
  var failure error;if r.Mode=="model_fault_diagnostic"{failure=errors.New("profile controlled inference failure")};gate,err:=newProfileModelGate(map[string]error{"profile-model-work":nil,"profile-model-peer":failure});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};modelGate=gate
  modelEffects:=profileModelEdges(t,home,modelGate)
  modelEffects.FactorySessionIDGenerator=effects.FactorySessionIDGenerator
  modelEffects.BrowserOpener=effects.BrowserOpener
  modelEffects.ProviderCommandRunner=effects.ProviderCommandRunner
  modelEffects.APIServerStarter=effects.APIServerStarter
  effects=modelEffects
 }
 process,err:=root.BuildProcess(ctx,effects)
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 defer func(){
  cleanup,stop:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer stop()
  r.LastBarrier="Process.Close"
  if err:=process.Close(cleanup);err!=nil{r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Error(err);return}
  if len(r.CleanupErrors)==0{r.Final=append(r.Final,r.capture(t,artifact,"Q2",nil,nil))}
 }()
 service,ok:=process.FactorySessions().FactorySessions().(sessions.Service)
 if !ok{t.Fatal("public Factory Sessions capability unavailable")}
 hostCtx,stopHost:=context.WithCancel(ctx)
 done:=make(chan error,1)
 go func(){done<-process.Execute(root.Input{Args:[]string{"you","run","--factory",filepath.Join(folder,"factory.json"),"--continuously","--with-server","--quiet","--no-record"},Env:[]string{"HOME="+home,"USERPROFILE="+home},Context:hostCtx,WorkingDirectory:folder,Stdout:io.Discard,Stderr:io.Discard})}()
 defer func(){
  stopHost();r.LastBarrier="Execute/server join"
  select{case err:=<-done:if err!=nil && !errors.Is(err,context.Canceled){r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Error(err)}
  case <-time.After(30*time.Second):r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,"Execute/server join ceiling reached");t.Error("Execute/server not joined")}
 }()
 r.LastBarrier="host readiness"
 select{case <-ready:case err:=<-done:done<-err;t.Fatalf("host exited before readiness: %v",err);case <-ctx.Done():t.Fatal(ctx.Err())}
 bootstrap,err:=service.List(ctx,sessions.SessionListRequest{Mode:sessions.SessionOperationModeLive});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 bootstrapIDs:=[]string{};for _,s:=range bootstrap.Sessions{bootstrapIDs=append(bootstrapIDs,s.SessionID)}
 r.Final=append(r.Final,r.capture(t,artifact,"HOST_BASELINE",nil,bootstrapIDs))
 if r.Mode=="model_diagnostic" || r.Mode=="model_fault_diagnostic" || r.Mode=="model_cancel_diagnostic" {
  r.modelDiagnostic(t,ctx,service,home,artifact,bootstrapIDs,modelGate)
  return
 }
 if r.Mode=="capability" {
  r.runCycles(t,ctx,service,home,folder,artifact,bootstrapIDs,1)
  return
 }
 r.attempt(t,"session",func(t *testing.T,a *profileAttempt){r.sessionAttempt(t,ctx,service,home,folder,artifact,bootstrapIDs,a)})
}
func (r *sampleProfile) sessionAttempt(t *testing.T,ctx context.Context,service sessions.Service,home,folder string,artifact artifactIdentity,bootstrap []string,a *profileAttempt) {
 id,runtimeID:=uuid.NewString(),uuid.NewString();a.SessionID=&id
 closed:=false
 defer func(){if !closed{
  cleanup,stop:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),30*time.Second);defer stop()
  result,err:=service.Control(cleanup,sessions.SessionControlRequest{SessionID:id,Mode:sessions.SessionOperationModeLive,Operation:sessions.SessionControlClose})
  if err!=nil && !errors.Is(err,sessions.ErrSessionNotFound){r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,err.Error());t.Error(err)} else if err==nil && !result.Closed{r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,"session cleanup not acknowledged");t.Error("session cleanup not acknowledged")}
 }}()
 r.LastBarrier="Start/Work/Close"
 started:=time.Now()
 defer func(){if a.Duration==nil{duration:=time.Since(started).Nanoseconds();a.Duration=&duration}}()
 opened,err:=service.Start(ctx,sessions.SessionStartRequest{SessionID:id,Mode:sessions.SessionOperationModeLive,FolderPath:folder,ActivationOnly:true,Correlation:sessions.SessionOperationCorrelation{RequestID:a.ID+"-open"},RuntimeSelection:&sessions.SessionRuntimeSelection{Mode:sessions.SessionRuntimeModeService,SystemConfigHome:home,RuntimeInstanceID:runtimeID}})
 if err!=nil || opened.SessionID!=id{t.Fatalf("Start: %#v %v",opened,err)}
 observer:=&smokeObserver{sessionID:id}
 a.Generations=[]string{observer.generation(t,ctx,service)}
 r.LastBarrier="terminal Work acknowledgment"
 observer.invoke(t,ctx,service,a.ID+"-work")
 r.LastBarrier="explicit Close acknowledgment"
 result,err:=service.Control(ctx,sessions.SessionControlRequest{SessionID:id,Mode:sessions.SessionOperationModeLive,Operation:sessions.SessionControlClose})
 duration:=time.Since(started).Nanoseconds();a.Duration=&duration
 if err!=nil || !result.Closed{t.Fatalf("Close: %#v %v",result,err)};closed=true
 a.Barriers=append(a.Barriers,profileBarrier{Name:"explicit Start/terminal Work/Close acknowledged",Joined:true})
 a.Checkpoints=append(a.Checkpoints,r.capture(t,artifact,"SAMPLE_CLOSED",a,bootstrap))
}
func (r *sampleProfile) capture(t *testing.T,artifact artifactIdentity,stage string,a *profileAttempt,bootstrap []string) profileCheckpoint {
 started:=time.Now();defer func(){r.CaptureNs+=time.Since(started).Nanoseconds()}()
 observer:=&smokeObserver{artifact:artifact,bootstrap:append([]string{},bootstrap...)}
 if a!=nil{observer.sessionID=*a.SessionID;observer.generations=a.Generations}
 observer.capture(t,"Q2","joined quiescent "+stage)
 report:=observer.reports[0];r.SnapshotCount++;r.Callbacks=len(report.Owners)
 return profileCheckpoint{Report:report,Stage:stage,Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"joined quiescent "+stage,Joined:true}}}
}
func (r *sampleProfile) emit(t *testing.T) {
 if t.Failed(){r.Errors=append(r.Errors,"selected workload failed; retain raw stdout/stderr")}
 complete:=!t.Failed() && r.validateSamples()==nil
 host,_:=os.Hostname();if host==""{host="unavailable"}
 summaries:=map[string]profileSummary{"inert":summarizeProfile(r.Attempts,"inert",false),"session":summarizeProfile(r.Attempts,"session",false)}
 payload:=map[string]any{"schemaVersion":1,"mode":r.Mode,"manifestPath":r.ManifestPath,"manifestSHA256":r.ManifestSHA256,
 "hostWindow":map[string]any{"confirmed":false,"authorityReference":nil,"host":host,"cpu":fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s; CPUs=%d",runtime.GOOS,runtime.GOARCH,runtime.NumCPU()),"memory":"not measured; shared host","cache":"owned runtime paths; cached preparation toolchain","startedUTC":r.Started,"endedUTC":time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),"coTenantBreach":false},
 "complete":complete,"baselineQualified":false,"lastBarrier":r.LastBarrier,"errors":r.Errors,"cleanupErrors":r.CleanupErrors,"attempts":r.Attempts,"summaries":summaries,"cycles":r.Cycles,"capacityWitnesses":r.CapacityWitnesses,"finalCheckpoints":r.Final,
 "overhead":map[string]any{"methodSHA256":r.Manifest.MethodSHA256,"registrationCallbacks":r.Callbacks,"retainedOwnerCallbacks":r.Callbacks,"snapshotCount":r.SnapshotCount,"captureOutsideSpanNs":r.CaptureNs,"serializationOutsideSpanNs":int64(0),"matchedFinalRequired":true}}
 path:=os.Getenv("OBSERVER_REPORT")
 data,err:=writeProfileReport(path,payload,json.MarshalIndent,os.WriteFile,time.Now)
 if err!=nil{t.Error(err);payload["complete"]=false;r.Errors=append(r.Errors,err.Error());payload["errors"]=r.Errors;data,_=json.MarshalIndent(payload,"","  ");if filepath.IsAbs(path){if writeErr:=os.WriteFile(path,data,0600);writeErr!=nil{t.Error(writeErr)}}}
 t.Log(string(data))
}

// The detached receipt records the final encoding and report write without
// recursively changing the bytes whose costs it measures. Its own encoding and
// write are outside that span; retain the raw test output and exit status too.
func writeProfileReport(path string,payload map[string]any,encode func(any,string,string)([]byte,error),write func(string,[]byte,os.FileMode)error,now func()time.Time)([]byte,error) {
 if !filepath.IsAbs(path){return nil,fmt.Errorf("absolute OBSERVER_REPORT required")}
 started:=now();_,err:=encode(payload,"","  ");first:=now().Sub(started).Nanoseconds()
 if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("initial report serialization: %w",err)}
 payload["overhead"].(map[string]any)["serializationOutsideSpanNs"]=first
 started=now();data,err:=encode(payload,"","  ");final:=now().Sub(started).Nanoseconds()
 if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("final report serialization: %w",err)}
 started=now();err=write(path,data,0600);writeNs:=now().Sub(started).Nanoseconds()
 if err!=nil{return data,fmt.Errorf("report write: %w",err)}
 hash:=sha256.Sum256(data)
 receipt:=map[string]any{"schemaVersion":1,"reportPath":path,"reportSHA256":hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]),"serializationOutsideSpanNs":first+final,"reportWriteOutsideSpanNs":writeNs,"totalOutsideSpanNs":first+final+writeNs,"receiptSpan":"receipt encoding/write and raw test logging excluded; outside lifecycle spans"}
 receiptData,err:=encode(receipt,"","  ");if err!=nil{return data,fmt.Errorf("overhead receipt serialization: %w",err)}
 if err=write(path+".overhead.json",receiptData,0600);err!=nil{return data,fmt.Errorf("overhead receipt write: %w",err)}
 return data,nil
}

func (r *sampleProfile) validateSamples() error {
 if r.Mode=="capability" || r.Mode=="profile" {
  if len(r.CapacityWitnesses)==0{return fmt.Errorf("missing composed public Models capacity witness")}
  for _,w:=range r.CapacityWitnesses{if err:=validateProfileCapacityWitness(w);err!=nil{return err}}
 }
 if len(r.Errors)>0 || len(r.CleanupErrors)>0 || r.Errors==nil || r.CleanupErrors==nil {return fmt.Errorf("workload or cleanup failure")}
 if len(r.Attempts)!=2 || len(r.Final)!=2 {return fmt.Errorf("incomplete sample workload")}
 kinds:=map[string]bool{};ids:=map[string]bool{}
 for _,a:=range r.Attempts {
  if !a.Valid || kinds[a.Kind] || ids[a.ID] || a.Ordinal!=1 {return fmt.Errorf("failed, duplicate or missing sample")}
  if err:=validateProfileAttempt(a);err!=nil{return err}
  kinds[a.Kind]=true;ids[a.ID]=true
 }
 if !kinds["inert"] || !kinds["session"] || r.Final[0].Stage!="HOST_BASELINE" || r.Final[1].Stage!="Q2" {return fmt.Errorf("missing workload or final join")}
 for _,c:=range r.Final {
  if err:=validateReport(c.Report);err!=nil{return err}
  if len(c.Barriers)==0{return fmt.Errorf("missing final join barrier")}
  for _,b:=range c.Barriers{if b.Name=="" || !b.Joined || b.Error!=nil{return fmt.Errorf("failed final join barrier")}}
 }
 return nil
}
func TestLifecycleProfileDriverMissingAttemptsAndCleanup(t *testing.T) {
 r:=&sampleProfile{Errors:[]string{},CleanupErrors:[]string{},Attempts:[]profileAttempt{},Final:[]profileCheckpoint{}}
 if r.validateSamples()==nil{t.Fatal("empty workload reported complete")}
 r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,"stop join canceled")
 if r.validateSamples()==nil{t.Fatal("cleanup failure reported complete")}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverArtifactIdentity(t *testing.T) {
 path:=filepath.Join(t.TempDir(),"artifact")
 if err:=os.WriteFile(path,[]byte("attested"),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 hash:=sha256.Sum256([]byte("attested"));expected:=hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
 if err:=checkProfileHash(path,expected);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(path,[]byte("changed"),0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if checkProfileHash(path,expected)==nil{t.Fatal("changed artifact accepted")}
 if checkProfileHash("relative",expected)==nil{t.Fatal("relative artifact accepted")}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverReportIO(t *testing.T) {
 path:=filepath.Join(t.TempDir(),"report.json")
 payload:=func()map[string]any{return map[string]any{"complete":true,"overhead":map[string]any{"serializationOutsideSpanNs":int64(0)}}}
 clock:=time.Unix(0,0)
 now:=func()time.Time{clock=clock.Add(time.Nanosecond);return clock}
 writes:=map[string][]byte{}
 writer:=func(path string,data []byte,_ os.FileMode)error{writes[path]=append([]byte{},data...);return nil}
 data,err:=writeProfileReport(path,payload(),json.MarshalIndent,writer,now)
 if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var receipt struct{ReportSHA256 string;SerializationOutsideSpanNs,ReportWriteOutsideSpanNs,TotalOutsideSpanNs int64}
 if err=json.Unmarshal(writes[path+".overhead.json"],&receipt);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 hash:=sha256.Sum256(data)
 if receipt.ReportSHA256!=hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]) || receipt.SerializationOutsideSpanNs!=2 || receipt.ReportWriteOutsideSpanNs!=1 || receipt.TotalOutsideSpanNs!=3{t.Fatalf("incorrect complete IO accounting: %#v",receipt)}
 cause:=errors.New("controlled IO failure")
 for _,failAt:=range []int{1,2,3}{
  calls:=0
  encoder:=func(value any,prefix,indent string)([]byte,error){calls++;if calls==failAt{return nil,cause};return json.MarshalIndent(value,prefix,indent)}
  if _,err=writeProfileReport(path,payload(),encoder,writer,now);!errors.Is(err,cause){t.Fatalf("encoding %d lost error: %v",failAt,err)}
 }
 for _,failAt:=range []int{1,2}{
  calls:=0
  failedWriter:=func(string,[]byte,os.FileMode)error{calls++;if calls==failAt{return cause};return nil}
  if _,err=writeProfileReport(path,payload(),json.MarshalIndent,failedWriter,now);!errors.Is(err,cause){t.Fatalf("write %d lost error: %v",failAt,err)}
 }
 if _,err=writeProfileReport("relative",payload(),json.MarshalIndent,writer,now);err==nil{t.Fatal("relative report path accepted")}
}

func TestLifecycleProfileDriverFinalJoins(t *testing.T) {
 duration:=int64(1);session:="owned-session"
 attempt:=func(kind string)profileAttempt{return profileAttempt{ID:kind,Kind:kind,Ordinal:1,Duration:&duration,Valid:true,SessionID:&session,Generations:[]string{"generation"},Noise:[]string{},Errors:[]string{},Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"closed",Joined:true}},Checkpoints:[]profileCheckpoint{{Report:validObserverReport(),Stage:"SAMPLE_CLOSED",Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"closed",Joined:true}}}}}}
 fresh:=func()*sampleProfile{return &sampleProfile{Errors:[]string{},CleanupErrors:[]string{},Attempts:[]profileAttempt{attempt("inert"),attempt("session")},Final:[]profileCheckpoint{{Report:validObserverReport(),Stage:"HOST_BASELINE",Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"ready",Joined:true}}},{Report:validObserverReport(),Stage:"Q2",Barriers:[]profileBarrier{{Name:"joined",Joined:true}}}}}}
 if err:=fresh().validateSamples();err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 canceled:=context.Canceled.Error()
 cases:=[]func(*sampleProfile){
  func(r *sampleProfile){r.Final[1].Barriers=nil},
  func(r *sampleProfile){r.Final[1].Barriers[0].Joined=false},
  func(r *sampleProfile){r.Final[1].Barriers[0].Error=&canceled},
  func(r *sampleProfile){r.Final[1].Report.OwnerInventoryComplete=false},
  func(r *sampleProfile){r.CleanupErrors=append(r.CleanupErrors,canceled)},
  func(r *sampleProfile){r.Attempts[1].Valid=false;r.Attempts[1].Errors=append(r.Attempts[1].Errors,canceled)},
 }
 for i,change:=range cases{r:=fresh();change(r);if r.validateSamples()==nil{t.Errorf("accepted failed final join case %d",i)}}
}
